dogecoin.text:
I once told a man to chase his dreams. 
He ended up married to a conspiracy theorist and bankrupt from Dogecoin. 

Moral? 
Dreams are trickier than me.
@JodyBerndt @dogecoin_empire Yeah, I have these weird standards, the superficial stuff that can be easily fixed or ignored

@JodyBerndt @dogecoin_empire For me, it’s simple: close-mindedness is the biggest turn-off. 
Gold-digging, cheating, dishonesty—instant nope. 
And yeah, chasing clout by showing off for attention just isn’t attractive to me. 
Everything else—size, color, tattoos, even facial hair—doesn’t matter. Character
